fields.why: Table 1 tests period (Delta vs BA.2/BA.5) by six race/ethnicity categories with one chi-square (single p = 0.10), and rates and symptom proportions are set out across 3 or more age groups.
Race/ethnicity is a margin of the Table 1 test; age groups (<6 mo to >=75 yrs; <1, 1-2, 3-5 mos) carry measured outcomes. Sex is 2 groups.

Rule 2/6: the race composition test is an omnibus test across 6 groups. Age results are side by side: the RRs are period contrasts within each age group (rule 6) and Table 2 has no tests, so the mechanical flags on the age entries are false alarms.
